description: This file defines the EventHandler interface for handling web events within the OFBiz framework. It declares methods for initializing the handler and invoking events, along with associated documentation.

classes.name: EventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling web events in the OFBiz framework, including initialization and invocation methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the ServletContext, used for setup tasks such as loading configuration files. Designed to be called only once due to singleton usage.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes a web event based on provided event information, request map, and HTTP request/response objects. Returns a result string and may throw an EventHandlerException.
